changelog:
Initial release of Discord Voice Plugin for Clawdbot:

- Enables real-time voice conversations in Discord channels, transcribing speech, processing it with Claude, and playing back responses.
- Supports multiple STT (OpenAI Whisper, Deepgram, Local Whisper) and TTS (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Kokoro) providers.
- Features voice activity detection, streaming STT, barge-in (interruptible bot speech), and automatic reconnect.
- Provides flexible configuration, supports CLI, slash commands, and integration as an agent tool.
- Requires Discord bot with voice permissions and system dependencies (ffmpeg, build tools).
- Includes detailed setup, configuration, and troubleshooting guidance.
summary: Enables real-time voice chat in Discord channels with speech-to-text, Claude AI processing, and text-to-speech playback supporting barge-in and auto-reconnect.
